criteria.criterion: A new unit test in crates/athena-core/src/reading/topics.rs builds Records with a job A cited only in a retry's introspection earlier_cases (job field) or in its cause/prevention text, not in the request text, and asserts referenced_jobs (or its replacement) returns A with its recorded reading_deliverables. Run `cargo test -p athena-core referenced` to check; the test fails on the base code, which ignores such ids, and passes with the change.
criteria.evidence: I ran `cargo test -p athena-core referenced` and 4 tests passed. Among them, referenced_jobs_returns_a_job_cited_only_by_the_introspection covers three variants: the earlier_cases job field, the cause text and the prevention text. Each asserts the job comes back with reading_deliverables == ["modify crates/x/a.rs","create crates/x/b.rs"]. Athena's fails-without-1 record shows that with the fix reverted these tests do not compile (exit 101, signature mismatch), so the failure on base is a compile error, not an assertion.

criteria.criterion: A test in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs builds a reader brief for a retry whose introspection cites a past job only by id, and asserts the brief contains that job's recorded deliverables, criteria and changed files under a heading for cited jobs. Run `cargo test -p athena-context brief` to check; it fails without the change.
criteria.evidence: I ran `cargo test -p athena-context brief` and 106 passed. a_retry_brief_shows_the_recorded_shape_of_a_job_only_its_introspection_cites asserts that the criteria and deliverables are quoted under '# Referenced jobs' and the changed files under the prior-result entry. Base referenced_jobs_section printed no criteria or deliverables, so the test would fail by assertion on base; I judged this by reading the base code, not by running it. The end-to-end test a_retry_resolves_the_cited_earlier_case_job_to_its_recorded_deliverables passed under `cargo test -p athena-cli --test retry` (25 passed). On base, the retry request names only the skipped job, so the section is absent and the test would fail.

criteria.criterion: A test shows the cause is generic: with two different cited jobs (different ids, different deliverable lists) both appear in the brief with their own recorded deliverables, ids from the request text come first, and the MAX_REFERENCED_JOBS cap never drops a request-named job. Run `cargo test -p athena-core -p athena-context`.
criteria.evidence: I ran `cargo test -p athena-core -p athena-context`, then reran it quietly with -q to read the totals. Results: 134 passed; 1297 passed and 1 ignored; 2 passed; 23 passed; 0 failed. referenced_jobs_lists_request_named_jobs_first_and_never_drops_one checks the order R1..R3 then the cited jobs, the MAX_CITED_JOBS cap, the dedupe, and that two cited jobs have different deliverables. two_cited_jobs_each_show_their_own_recorded_deliverables_in_order checks the same in the brief.

criteria.criterion: The doc comment on referenced_jobs in crates/athena-core/src/reading/topics.rs names the root cause (ids cited by introspection were never resolved to recorded deliverables, so fixtures and thresholds were invented), and the CHANGELOG.md Unreleased entry states it and lists jobs 20261109-075120-7zqw, 20261029-111121-fzx0 and 20261110-124307-bn3c as the instances. Check with Grep on both files.
criteria.evidence: I read topics.rs lines 565-568. The doc says ids an introspection cited 'were never resolved to the deliverables recorded for those jobs, so a reading built its fixtures and thresholds from an assumed shape that was invented.' The CHANGELOG Unreleased '### Fixed' entry, which I read in the diff, names the three jobs as instances, and referenced_jobs_doc_and_changelog_name_the_cause passed. The wording is present, but calling these jobs instances of this cause is contradicted by the records; see the findings.

criteria.criterion: The change adds no new refusal or matching rule: `git diff` shows no new step! in refusing_check in crates/athena-core/src/reading/checks.rs and no new check function, so no newly refused share applies. check_prior_result_and_scope and continued_jobs behave as before; their existing tests still pass.
criteria.evidence: `git diff HEAD~1 --stat` lists no checks.rs, and continued_jobs is unchanged in the diff. `cargo test -p athena-core --test refusal_corpus` passed 23 of 23, including the new introspection-cited-job-carried-but-not-relied-on case. Athena's replay found 0 of 50 accepted readings newly refused.

criteria.criterion: The 'Referenced jobs' and 'Previous result and change scope' brief sections for cited-only jobs print the recorded deliverables, with no line starting with `Job ` added inside carried_work, and the reader prompt files are unchanged (git diff shows no prompt file edit; the reader prompt set has 2 tokens of headroom).
criteria.evidence: The diff does not touch carried_work or any file under crates/athena-context/prompts. The briefs test asserts exactly 2 'Job ' lines in the prior section. `cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets` passed 7 of 7, including system_facts_budgets_match_computed.

criteria.criterion: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` pass.

findings.summary: The named root cause is contradicted by the recorded instances, so the change would not prevent the failure class it cites.
findings.evidence: Evidence snapshot, records/jobs/2026-11/20261109-075120-7zqw/request.json: 7zqw was not a retry, and its request text names jobs 20261025-183644-t67q and 20261017-205554-zaj2 directly. Base referenced_jobs already resolves ids in the request text through job_ids_in and carry(). Base prior_result_section chains referenced_jobs and prints 'Allowed change scope, deliverables' (base test a_follow_up_brief_carries_the_result_and_scope_of_each_named_job, briefs.rs:3896). The verification of the earlier attempt at this same fix (records/jobs/2026-11/20261110-124254-zegf/verification.json) found that 7zqw's reader saw those deliverables and still wrote 'zaj2 (12 deliverables)', where the record has 11. Introspections 20261110-124233-20rr (fzx0) and 20261110-144807-kchg (bn3c) say those jobs failed because a word-matching or parsing rule was never run over recorded requests; neither failure involves an unresolved job id. For bn3c, the new code would carry job 7zqw (via 20rr's earlier case yxah), a size-check job unrelated to bn3c's code-fence flaw. The originating gap is still open: nothing makes a rule's fixtures and thresholds come from the recorded shapes, and nothing runs the rule over recorded requests. Simpler and more correct: fix that gap, for example by requiring fixtures to be loaded from records, or by running a new rule over recorded requests before the verdict.

findings.summary: Every carried job's deliverable list is now printed twice in the reader brief.
findings.evidence: referenced_jobs_section now quotes reading_deliverables, and prior_result_section (reader.rs:169-179) already quotes the same list for every job in inputs.referenced_jobs. Introspection-cited jobs now add up to 4 more such entries. Criterion 6 asks for both sections, so this is planned, but it costs reader context and was a major finding on job zegf.

findings.summary: A changed file is outside the expected deliverables list.
findings.evidence: crates/athena-cli/tests/retry.rs is modified but is not on the expected deliverables list. It is in the planned files and holds only a new test.

findings.summary: The fails-without demonstrations for criteria 1, 3 and 4 fail by compile error, not by assertion.
findings.evidence: Athena's fails-without-1, -3 and -4 records show E0308 errors from the signature change. The assertion-level failure on base rests on the retry.rs and briefs.rs tests, which I judged by reading the base code.

findings.summary: The reading does not match the request, so passing criteria do not show the request was met
findings.evidence: The request asks for the cause to be found where it originates, starting from what information the failing stage lacked. The reading says the gap is that ids cited only by a retry's introspection were never resolved. The records contradict this. Job 7zqw was not a retry, and the jobs it cited were named in its own request text. The base code already resolves such ids and already shows their recorded deliverables to the reader, and the reader saw them and still miscounted. Jobs fzx0 and bn3c failed because rules were never run over recorded requests, not because of unresolved ids. So the reading fixes a real but different gap, and the CHANGELOG wrongly lists the three jobs as instances of it. This repeats the misdiagnosis for which the earlier attempt at this fix (job 20261110-124254-zegf) was rejected.

summary: This change should not land, because it does not fix the cause of the failures it cites. For a retried job, the reader brief now shows the recorded criteria, deliverables and changed files of every past job the retry's introspection cites, and no refusal rule is added. The tests pass: athena-core referenced (4), athena-context brief (106), athena-cli retry (25), the refusal corpus (23) and budgets (7), and the full athena-core plus athena-context run (0 failures); Athena's recorded fmt, clippy and test checks passed. But the evidence snapshot contradicts the root cause the change names. Job 7zqw was not a retry: its request named the jobs it cited, the base code already showed their recorded deliverables, and its reader still wrote 12 deliverables where the record has 11. Jobs fzx0 and bn3c failed because new rules were never run over recorded requests, which has nothing to do with unresolved ids. The new mechanism would not have prevented any of the three. The CHANGELOG still lists them as instances, and the gap that caused them, rule fixtures and thresholds not taken from records, stays open. Every criterion is met, but the verdict is fail on that major finding and the reading mismatch. Minor issues: deliverable lists printed twice, and retry.rs changed outside the deliverables list.
